vo.en: Pick a color and a shape. I'm reading your mind.

vo.en: Don't overthink it. First thing that hits your brain, lock it in right now.

vo.en: Most people try to pick something complex to trick me, but I've already primed your subconscious.

vo.en: Wait. Don't you dare change it. I can see you thinking about switching right now.

visual.description: A man in a dark suit pointing his finger directly at the lens with a serious, knowing look.

vo.en: Your brain relies on cognitive shortcuts. I'm using dark psychology to force your choice into a corner.

visual.description: Fast-paced geometric tunnel of white lines rushing toward the viewer in a black void.

vo.en: The color is Red. The shape is a Triangle. I just caught you, didn't I?

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow's brain test and comment YES if this worked. You can't help but...
